increment: Shared workshop ownership and station reservations

behavior.ownership: Mill coordinate plus dimension; first UI assignment claims the mill for its player. Operators can authorize use without replacing its owner.
behavior.reservation: Worker UUID and exact job ID reserve both endpoints or neither, until delivery completes. No cargo or haul is created for denied assignments.
behavior.waiting: Earlier overlapping requests have priority; unrelated endpoints can proceed. Only ungranted requests expire (120 ticks).
behavior.persistence: Stop, pause, chunk unload and graceful restart retain active cargo and leases. Holders are not loaded or timed out to free reservations.
behavior.cleanup: Loaded job reconciliation or worker destruction releases the matching lease; dimension changes retain the original lease and job waits in the wrong dimension.
